purpose: Reconcile every A11 attempt ever executed against the formal RELIABILITY-MATRIX, after independent review found that the published '1/8 rounds hit the 15s shutdown deadline' could not be derived from the formal matrix alone.
attemptModel: one attempt = one experiment round of A11

harnessVersions.v1: initial harness; probe/summary plumbing defects (playwright imported from the harness directory); A11 verdict semantics: closeError===null required for CLEAN
harnessVersions.v2: playwright import fixed; verdict semantics still v1 (any deadline hit => DIRTY)
harnessVersions.v3: verdict semantics aligned with the PR contract: CLOSE-CLEAN (joined, cache removed, endpoint closed) and CLOSE-BOUNDED-FAIL (deadline reject, endpoint closed, cache retained, error visible) are both spec-compliant; anything else is CLOSE-DIRTY

attempts.behavior: no experiment executed: playwright import failed (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND) before any resource was created
attempts.rawEvidenceNote: per-round evidence files of run1 were overwritten by later same-name runs; the run log survives

attempts.reclassificationBasis: durationMs 15360 matches the 15s deadline signature; the identical signature is recorded as CLOSE-BOUNDED-FAIL in run3 r4 with full evidence. The recorded v2 verdict DIRTY is preserved verbatim and is not rewritten.
attempts.loadavgProxySource: A9-midstart-shutdown-r1.json before.audit at 16:25:31Z (nearest surviving run2 record)

statistics.validDenominatorDefinition: attempts in which the experiment actually executed (server created, close() invoked); harness-defect attempts are excluded
statistics.correctionOfPriorClaim: The previously published '1/8 rounds hit the deadline' mixed the formal-round hit count (1) with the valid-attempt denominator (8). The reconciled figures are 2/8 across all valid attempts and 1/5 across the formal final-semantics rounds. No attempt was reclassified as PASS; the correction only fixes the denominator and surfaces the run2 bounded-fail round.
statistics.loadCaveat: Every valid attempt ran under elevated system load. run2 proxies: 1-min loadavg ~14-15 on 10 cores. run3 (formal): 1-min loadavg 80.28-105.19 recorded in the rounds' own audits; no lab work was concurrent with run3 A11 (verified by artifact timestamps), so the spike is external system load. There is no normal-load sample, and n is far too small for any probability statement. The bounded-fail rate must not be read as a normal-load timeout probability for PR #38.
statistics.loadResponseNote: Within run3 the deadline hit occurred at a 1-min loadavg of 93.41 while the cleanest round ran at 105.19 - no monotonic load-response is derivable from n=5.

conclusion: A11 supports the qualitative claim only: 'under elevated system load, close() during live traffic can occasionally require the full 15s deadline (2 of 8 valid attempts; 1 of 5 formal rounds), and when it does, the PR contract holds (endpoint closed, cache retained, cleanupIncomplete marked, error visible, no false PASS).' Quantitative probability claims are unsupported and withdrawn.
